Expanding: (10-x)² + (x-16)² = 100 - 20x + x² + x² - 32x + 256 = 2x² - 52x + 356. Right side: x² + (x² - 12x + 36) = 2x² - 12x + 36. Setting equal: -52x + 356 = -12x + 36 → 320 = 40x → x = 8.

Solution 2 made an arithmetic error: 100 + 256 = 356, not 52 (the constants were mishandled), and the x² terms were also mis-simplified. Its answer (1,5) is wrong. Verify: PO² = 1 + 25 = 26, PA² = 81 + 225 = 306, which are not equal.
